$ aws-login --bogus
--- stdout
--- stderr
aws-login: unknown option: --bogus
aws-login — sign the AWS CLI in to an IAM Identity Center session.

Usage: aws-login [profile] [--renew] [--use-device-code] [--no-browser]
       aws-login [profile] --status
  profile            an SSO profile from ~/.aws/config (default: planlab-prod)
  --renew            sign out and start a new session even when the profile
                     already works; restarts the session's clock
  --use-device-code  device-code flow instead of the browser redirect; the
                     default on the office minis, where the laptop's browser
                     cannot reach their localhost listener
  --no-browser       print the sign-in URL instead of opening a browser
  --status           report the current session and exit 1 when the profile
                     has no working credentials; signs nothing in or out
--- exit 2
--- aws calls
--- stamps
